normalization_policy: All CD basis masks retain the unmasked triple norm product plus 1e-30 in the denominator.
coordinate_ablation_boundary: Masks remove staple coordinates. Each physical sample can occur in multiple overlapping staples, so an e8-slot mask does not remove lag-2 Bx from every representation.

channels.name: cd_associator
channels.what_it_measures: full 16D CD cubic mismatch on six samples

channels.name: max_rotation
channels.what_it_measures: max stepwise angle of B in the same six samples

channels.name: mag_jump
channels.what_it_measures: max |B| minus min |B| in the same six samples

channels.name: cd_magnitude_zeroed
channels.what_it_measures: CD associator after clearing every |B| channel

channels.name: cd_e8_zeroed
channels.what_it_measures: CD basis-coordinate ablation clearing e8 in each overlapping staple; repeated Bx samples survive in other coordinates

channels.name: cd_quaternion_lag0
channels.what_it_measures: CD associator on lag-0 only; algebraically associative, expect chance

channels.name: cd_octonion_two_lag
channels.what_it_measures: CD associator on lags 0-1 (octonion prefix e0..e7)

channels.name: cd_lags_1_2
channels.what_it_measures: CD associator keeping only lags 1 and 2

channels.name: cd_lags_2_3
channels.what_it_measures: CD associator keeping only lags 2 and 3

channels.name: mva_lm_rotation
channels.what_it_measures: max LM-plane rotation from Sonnerup-Cahill MVA on the six samples

channels.name: mva_delta_bl
channels.what_it_measures: max minus min B along the MVA maximum-variance axis

channels.name: b_path_length
channels.what_it_measures: hodogram arc length in R^3: sum |dB| over the six samples

channels.name: gram_volume
channels.what_it_measures: max |det(dB_i, dB_{i+1}, dB_{i+2})|: 3D parallelepiped volume, zero for planar B

channels.name: rank_rotation_plus_mag_jump
channels.what_it_measures: sum of ranks of max_rotation and mag_jump; no fitted weights
